description: This open API lists the amount of electricity generated in South Korea by power source for each hour of the day, published by the Korea Power Exchange through the Public Data Portal. The Exchange runs the electricity market and the power system operation, so the data come from the settlement side of the market, and the description warns that some figures may change with later revisions because it is electricity transaction settlement data. The service is a REST API returning JSON and XML, classified under energy and resource development, registered on 21 September 2022 and edited on 29 June 2026, with a real-time update cycle. Access: free of charge with an API key from the portal, so registration is needed; the development account is limited to 100 requests and a production account needs review, and the terms state that the range of use permission is limitless. Coverage is national. Caveats: spatial and temporal range fields are empty on the page, and the data are settlement figures subject to revision. It suits capacity planning and network flow studies of the Korean power system, and relates to the KPX hourly national electricity demand record catalogued here.
